evidence: The ALD process consisted of the following 4 steps: TDMASn 1 s – Ar 40 s – H2S 3 s – Ar 50 s. These steps composed a single cycle of ALD and 10, 15, 25 and 30 cycle depositions were performed. The pressure ALD process was maintained at 1.27 torr with 200 sccm Ar flowing at 150 oC deposition temperature.
